title: Chirality: Why Nature Prefers One Hand
question: Physics allows molecules to be built either left-handed or right-handed with equal ease, so why does nearly all life on Earth use only one of each?
summary: Your left hand and right hand are mirror images that can never be superimposed, and the same is true of countless molecules. Life picked a side almost two billion years before anyone existed to ask why, and we still are not certain how the choice was made.
